**Executive power** of the State vested in the Governor, exercised directly or through subordinate officers

**Term** – **during the pleasure of the President**; resigns to the President; normal term **5 years** (156(3))
**Qualifications** – **citizen of India** (by birth or otherwise) and **completed 35 years**
**Conditions** – not a member of Parliament or a State Legislature (seat vacated on appointment), no **office of profit**; emoluments fixed by **Parliament by law**, not reduced during the term
